# Lucas Daneluz — Product Manager

> Product Manager with 10+ years of experience across B2B SaaS, FMCG, and supply chain. Based in the UK. Open to PM roles.

Lucas transitioned into product from commercial and operational roles — category management, procurement, and supply chain. That path gives him a commercially grounded perspective on product decisions and a strong track record of cross-functional alignment across engineering, finance, and operations.

Core strengths: product discovery, stakeholder alignment, roadmap prioritisation, user research, and working in ambiguity.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Work overview](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/work): All case studies and selected projects
- [WalkUp — Smarter Queues](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/walkup): Improved trust, queue transparency, and retention in a two-sided marketplace. Outcome: 3× loyalty engagement uplift. Tags: Marketplace, Waitlist UX, Loyalty.
- [Hipen Media — User Onboarding](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/hipen-media): Reduced onboarding friction across multiple customer segments with a lean MVP. Outcome: 40% faster onboarding completion. Tags: Discovery, Onboarding, MVP, B2B SaaS.
- [Westpak — Cost Optimisation](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/westpak): Aligned finance and operations around a cost-saving initiative without disrupting supply. Outcome: 25% cost reduction. Tags: Stakeholder Management, Cost Optimisation, Supply Chain.
- [Run Your Pace — Personal Build](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/run-your-pace): Shipped a Couch-to-5K training app from scratch to solve a personal UX problem. Live and used weekly. Tags: Personal Build, React, Side Project.
